basics.name: Cecil Sithole
basics.summary: I am a double cum laude graduate with an honors degree in Information Systems, currently pursuing my Master of Commerce in Information Technology at the University of Johannesburg. As a full-stack software developer with three years of hands-on experience, I currently work as a Software Engineer Graduate at BMW South Africa, specializing in web development, database design, cloud computing, API integration, and Driver Assistance Functions testing. I have architected and deployed cloud-native solutions used across BMW plants globally, including comprehensive tracking tools and project management systems.

items.summary: Responsible for digitalization and testing Driver Assistance Functions for X3 G45. Developed comprehensive tracking tool consolidating data from multiple sources, enabling technicians and engineers to manage testing cars efficiently. Architected and deployed full-stack solution using modern cloud-native architecture with AWS ECS Fargate. Created Spring Validation Tool deployed globally across BMW plants in South Africa, Germany, Mexico, USA, and China for visualizing car weight distribution and spring measurements.

Built Project Management Tool to manage all X3 G45 projects, automating data aggregation from multiple sources and replacing manual Excel processes. Deployed enterprise solution now used by entire BMW Plant 09 for project management steering. Reduced human errors through automation and enabled real-time data synchronization with web-based access to build plans.

Tutored and mentored students in software development module and programming fundamentals. Guided students through core programming concepts, provided one-on-one mentoring, and facilitated practical coding sessions and workshops.
